message:
fix(ka-pc r4): a reservation keeps its place, pump/exit under one lock, the fence waits for its releases, per-PC exit status, connect cancel vs owner end (Codex R1-R4, decision 1)

- R1 a reservation counts as a PC until it succeeds or is given back (a standby released meanwhile does not hand
  its place to another candidate); a candidate that would still be a fourth at commit is closed, and the user told
- R2 note_pump_end / note_exit_decided: whichever comes first, under gConnectedMu; nothing is left behind
- R3 the owner fence queues the held releases, gates new input at once, and closes only when the input queue is
  empty, no input exchange is in flight (the host acks each) and the control channel holds nothing unacknowledged
  -- or after 2 s; test build only: REMOTE60_VIEWER_TEST_HOLD_SEND_AFTER_FENCE_MS holds the sender after the fence
- R4 every ordinary exit / reconnect / failure status carries its hostId; an ordinary connect ends its own card's
  connecting mark ('<PC> 연결됨')
- decision 1: two events -- --cancel-event calls off a CONNECT only ('no effect' on an established session),
  --owner-end-event is the owner's end (the fence); a replaced viewer that had connected stays this owner's
  (gReplacedViewers) until it exits or the owner ends
- tests: every test host starts with --config {enableInputInjection:false, forceEncodedExperiment:true} and no
  viewer connects before the host says 'input injection disabled' (GNLinkStream injects by default; before this,
  each session start's modifier key-ups reached this PC's input). The injection-off e2e has NOT run yet
  (the verifier asked to hold real-host e2e until Codex decides the standard).
